Honestly, before Autumn, our sign-ups were a black box.

Someone would sign up with their Gmail, and I'd be like, okay, who is this? I would have 10 tabs open, LinkedIn, GitHub, their X, trying to just piece things together. And most days, I wasn't able to get to it.
And now I don't even think about it. Somebody signs up, and we get notified in Slack. And by the time I look at it, Autumn's already figured out who they are and what they're working on.
There was this one sign-up that looked totally random, just a personal email, and it turned out to be the CTO of a team that we'd been dying to work with.
We reached out the same day and got a Slack channel set up with them. This is the part that I love. It saves us time by catching people that I would have completely missed.
